subject: Lebanon
assessment: ANALYSIS: Lebanon's systemic friction stems from political paralysis, currency devaluation, port/logistics constraints, and a fragmented regulatory environment, creating high resistance to skill and resource deployment. Concurrently, a highly educated diaspora, strategic Mediterranean positioning, and latent reconstruction demand offer strategic upside. RESOLUTION: Applying the UESP 33° PRCE protocol quantifies friction (SHI) and deployment efficiency (TTI), enabling precision intervention. DISPATCH: Creative -> Media/Entertainment exports; Technical -> IT infrastructure & digital services; Operational -> Supply chain & logistics optimization; Labor -> Skilled trades for reconstruction; Intellectual -> Policy & academic partnerships. MAP: Skills routed to Global Industry Avenues (EU tech hubs, MENA reconstruction funds, diaspora investment networks).
